exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple or the present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
SANDRANING UELSDAN YOZGAN XATI (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Dear Donna,
  I AM WRITING to you from Wales. I am on holiday with my
  family. We ARE VISITING my grandparents in a lovely village
  called St John's. We COME here every year.
  Sometimes it RAINS in March but this time the weather is
  beautiful and the sun IS SHINING.
  St John's is a very quiet place and it is nice to go for
  walks on the beach or have picnics in the countryside.
  This week we ARE very busy, because there is a special
  celebration on Saturday. The village is having a street
  party. Everyone IS WORKING very hard to decorate the streets
  and to build a stage for dancing and playing music. All the
  women ARE COOKING delicious food and ARE MAKING cakes.
  I AM HAVING a really good time.
  See you soon.
  Love, Sandra

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Hurmatli Donna,
  Men senga Uelsdan yozyapman. Oilam bilan ta'tildaman.
  Biz Sent-Jons degan go'zal qishloqda bobom-buvimникига
  mehmonga kelganmiz. Biz bu yerga har yili kelamiz.
  Ba'zan martda yomg'ir yog'adi, lekin bu safar ob-havo
  ajoyib va quyosh charaqlayapti.
  Sent-Jons juda tinch joy va plyajda sayr qilish yoki
  qishloqda piknik qilish yoqimli.
  Bu hafta biz juda bandmiz, chunki shanba kuni maxsus
  bayram bo'ladi. Qishloqda ko'cha bayrami o'tkazilyapti.
  Hamma ko'chalarni bezash va raqs hamda musiqa uchun
  sahna qurishga juda harakat qilyapti. Ayollarning hammasi
  mazali taom pishirayapti va tort tayyorlayapti. Men juda
  yaxshi vaqt o'tkazyapman.
  Tez orada ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Sandra

ZAMON TANLASH:
  every year, Sometimes → PRESENT SIMPLE
  hozir, This week      → PRESENT CONTINUOUS

DIQQAT — 'EVERYONE' BIRLIK:
  Everyone IS working ('everyone are' XATO).
  'All the women' esa KO'PLIK → ARE cooking.

items.whyUz:
Xat yozish — hozir sodir bo'layotgan ish → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + writing (-e TUSHDI).

items.textEn: We 2) ............ (visit) my grandparents in a lovely village called St John's.
items.whyUz:
Vaqtinchalik holat → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'We' → ARE + visiting (undosh IKKILANMAYDI — urg'u 1-bo'g'inda).
'called ...' = ... deb ataladigan.

'every year' → PRESENT SIMPLE (har yili takrorlanadi).
'We' — ko'plik → -S QO'SHILMAYDI: COME.

'Sometimes' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
Ob-havoda ega 'it' — birlik → rainS.
'in March' — oy nomi oldida IN.

items.textEn: ... but this time the weather is beautiful and the sun 5) ............ (shine).
items.whyUz:
'this time' = bu safar — HOZIRGI holat → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'the sun' — birlik → IS + shining (-e TUSHDI).
4 va 5-bandni solishtiring: odatda yomg'ir, LEKIN hozir quyoshli.

'be' — HOLAT fe'li, -ing shaklida ishlatilmaydi.
'we' → ARE.
'busy' = band.

items.textEn: Everyone 7) ............ (work) very hard to decorate the streets.
items.whyUz:
'This week' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Everyone' — ma'nosi ko'plik, lekin GRAMMATIK jihatdan BIRLIK → IS.
'Everyone are working' XATO.

'All the women' — KO'PLIK → ARE + cooking.
7-band bilan solishtiring: 'everyone' birlik, 'all the women' ko'plik.
'delicious' = mazali.

Ega o'zgarmagan → ARE + making (-e TUSHDI).
'a cake' = tort, kek.

'have a good time' = yaxshi vaqt o'tkazmoq — HARAKAT → -ing mumkin.
'I' → AM + having (-e TUSHDI).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the questions below to fill in the blanks.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLAR RO'YXATI:
  What's her favourite colour
  What about a nice dress
  Can I help you
  What do you think of this T-shirt
  How old is she
  What size is she

DO'KONDAGI SUHBAT MANTIG'I:
  1) Sotuvchi yordam taklif qiladi
  2) Yosh so'raydi (sovg'a tanlash uchun)
  3) Biror narsa taklif qiladi
  4) Rang so'raydi
  5) O'lcham so'raydi
  6) Fikrini so'raydi

FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  Can I help you?          — Yordam bera olamanmi?
  I'm looking for ...      — Men ... qidiryapman
  What about ...?          — ... qanday bo'lar ekan?
  What do you think of ...? — ... haqida nima deysiz?
  What size is she?        — U qaysi o'lchamda?
  Here you are.            — Mana, oling.

lines.whyUz:
'Can I help you?' = Yordam bera olamanmi?
Do'konda sotuvchi shu ibora bilan boshlaydi.

lines.textEn: Yes, thank you. I'm looking for a present for my daughter.

lines.whyUz:
Javobda 'dresses' aytilgan → savolda 'a nice dress' taklif qilingan.
'What about ...?' — taklif kiritish iborasi.

lines.textEn: Oh no! She never wears dresses.
Okay. What would your daughter like?
Well, she likes red a lot.

lines.whyUz:
Javob O'LCHAM ('a twelve') → 'What size is she?'
Britaniyada ayollar kiyimi o'lchami: 8, 10, 12, 14 ...

lines.answer: What do you think of this T-shirt
lines.whyUz:
Javob BAHO ('It's lovely') → fikr so'ralgan.
'What do you think OF ...?' — 'of' predlogi shart.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the questions below to fill in the blanks.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOLLAR RO'YXATI:
  How much are they
  Do you have any
  Can I help you
  How many would you like

KANSELYARIYA DO'KONIDAGI SUHBAT:
  1) Sotuvchi yordam taklif qiladi
  2) Xaridor bor-yo'qligini so'raydi
  3) Sotuvchi sonini so'raydi
  4) Xaridor narxini so'raydi

PUL BIRLIKLARI (Britaniya):
  p  = pence (pens) — mayda pul
  £  = pound (funt) — 1 funt = 100 pens
  50p each = har biri 50 pens
  4 × 50p = 200p = £2 (two pounds)

FOYDALI IBORALAR:
  Do you have any ...?     — Sizda ... bormi?
  How many would you like? — Nechta xohlaysiz?
  How much are they?       — Ular qancha turadi?
  ... each                 — har biri
  I'd like ...             — Men ... olsam deb edim
  How much is that?        — Hammasi qancha bo'ladi?

lines.whyUz: 'Can I help you?' — do'konda sotuvchining odatiy boshlanishi.

lines.textEn: Yes, I'm looking for some pencils. 2) ............ ?
lines.whyUz:
Mahsulot bor-yo'qligi so'ralmoqda → 'Do you have any?'
SAVOLDA 'any' ishlatiladi (tasdiqda 'some').

Javob SON ('Four') → 'How many would you like?'
'pencils' sanaladi → HOW MANY ('how much' XATO).

Javob NARX → 'How much are they?'
'they' — qalamlar ko'plikda → ARE.

lines.textEn: Good. I'd like these four. How much is that?

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda berilgan so'zlar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BERILGAN SO'ZLAR:
  envelopes ......... konvertlar
  pens .............. ruchkalar
  rubbers ........... o'chirg'ichlar (britancha)
                      amerikacha: erasers
  pencil sharpeners . qalam yo'nadigan asboblar

Quyida har bir mahsulot uchun to'liq dialog berilgan.
Narxlarni o'zingiz o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.

example.speaker: B
example.en: Yes, I'm looking for some envelopes. Do you have any?
example.uz: Ha, men konvert qidiryapman. Sizda bormi?

example.speaker: A
example.en: Yes, of course. How many would you like?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Ten please. How much are they?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Good. I'd like these ten. How much is that?
example.uz: Yaxshi. Shu o'ntasini olsam. Hammasi qancha bo'ladi?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Yes, I'm looking for some pens. Do you have any?
example.uz: Ha, men ruchka qidiryapman. Sizda bormi?

example.speaker: A
example.en: Yes, of course. How many would you like?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Three please. How much are they?

example.speaker: A (o'chirg'ichlar)
example.en: Yes, I'm looking for some rubbers. Do you have any?
example.uz: Ha, men o'chirg'ich qidiryapman. Sizda bormi?

example.speaker: B
example.en: Two please. How much are they? — They're 30p each.
example.uz: Ikkita, iltimos. Ular qancha turadi? — Har biri 30 pens.

example.speaker: A (qalam yo'nadigan)
example.en: Yes, I'm looking for some pencil sharpeners. Do you have any?
example.uz: Ha, men qalam yo'nadigan asbob qidiryapman. Sizda bormi?

example.speaker: B
example.en: One please. How much is it? — It's 45p.

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QAHRAMON:
  Ian  — uyda, Angliyada
  Paul — Yamaykada ta'tilda, xotini Sonia bilan

TELEFON SUHBATI IBORALARI:
  Hello?              — Alo? (qo'ng'iroqni olganda)
  Hi ..., it's ...    — Salom ..., bu ...
  How are you?        — Qalaysiz?
  Where are you phoning from? — Qayerdan qo'ng'iroq qilyapsiz?

sentences.noteUz: Telefonda qo'ng'iroqni olgan odam shunday deydi (so'roq ohangi bilan).

Telefonda o'zini tanishtirish: 'it's + ism'.
'I am Paul' — telefonda ISHLATILMAYDI.

sentences.en: Ian: Paul! How are you? How's Sonia?
Paul: Fine, we're both very well. You can't imagine how lovely it is here in Jamaica.
sentences.uz: Pol: Yaxshi, ikkalamiz ham juda yaxshimiz. Bu yerda, Yamaykada qanchalik go'zal ekanini tasavvur ham qila olmaysan.
sentences.noteUz:
'both' = ikkalasi ham.
'how lovely it is' — bilvosita gapda tartib ODDIY qoladi.
Jamaica — Karib dengizidagi orol-davlat.

sentences.en: Paul: It's very hot and the sun's shining.
sentences.uz: Pol: Juda issiq va quyosh charaqlayapti.
sentences.noteUz: 'the sun's shining' = the sun IS shining (qisqartma).

sentences.en: Ian: Where's Sonia? Is she with you?
sentences.uz: Ian: Sonia qayerda? U sen bilanmi?

sentences.en: Paul: Sonia is sunbathing in her swimming costume near the pool.
sentences.uz: Pol: Sonia hovuz yonida cho'milish kiyimida quyoshda toblanayapti.
sentences.noteUz:
'near the pool' = hovuz yonida.
'IN her swimming costume' — kiyim uchun IN.

sentences.en: Ian: And where are you phoning from?
sentences.noteUz:
'phone from' — 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.
'to phone' = qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

sentences.en: Paul: At the moment, I'm sitting on the balcony of our hotel room.
sentences.uz: Pol: Ayni paytda men mehmonxona xonamizning balkonida o'tiribman.
sentences.noteUz:
'at the moment' — Present Continuous belgisi.
'ON the balcony' — balkon yuzasida → ON.

sentences.en: Paul: I'm enjoying the wonderful view.
Paul: Hey, have you got Jack's address?
sentences.uz: Pol: Ey, senda Jekning manzili bormi?
sentences.noteUz:
'have got' savoli: HAVE + ega + GOT.
'Jack's address' — egalik apostrofi.

sentences.en: Paul: Because I want to send him a postcard.
sentences.uz: Pol: Chunki men unga otkritka jo'natmoqchiman.
sentences.noteUz:
'Why' savoliga javob DOIM 'Because' bilan.
'want TO send' — 'want' dan keyin 'to + fe'l'.
'send somebody something' = kimgadir nimadir jo'natmoq.

exercises.explanationUz:
Javoblarni telefon suhbatidan toping.
Bu javoblar 16-mashqdagi otkritka uchun REJA bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 1  Which country are Paul and Sonia in?
items.whyUz:
Pol: 'how lovely it is here in Jamaica'.
Jamaica — Karib dengizidagi issiq orol.

items.answer: It's very hot and the sun is shining.
items.whyUz: Pol: 'It's very hot and the sun's shining.'

Pol: 'Sonia is sunbathing ... near the pool.'
'a pool' = suzish havzasi.

items.answer: She is wearing her swimming costume.
items.whyUz:
Pol: 'in her swimming costume'.
'be IN + kiyim' = 'wear' bilan bir xil ma'noda.

items.answer: He is on the balcony of their hotel room.
items.whyUz:
Pol: 'I'm sitting on the balcony of our hotel room.'
DIQQAT: Polning gapida 'our', javobda esa 'their' bo'ladi.

items.answer: He is sitting on the balcony and enjoying the wonderful view.
items.whyUz:
Pol: 'I'm sitting on the balcony ... I'm enjoying the wonderful view.'
U shu paytda Ian bilan telefonda ham gaplashayapti.

exercises.instructionEn: Using your answers from Ex. 15 write Paul's postcard to Jack.
exercises.instructionUz: 15-mashqdagi javoblaringizdan foydalanib, Polning Jekka yozgan otkritkasini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
OTKRITKA TUZILISHI (Coursebook 49-betdagi namunalar kabi):

  1) Murojaat:     Dear Jack,
  2) Salomlashish: Greetings from Jamaica!
  3) Ob-havo:      It's very hot and the sun is shining.
  4) Kim nima qilayapti (Present Continuous)
  5) Yakun:        See you soon.
  6) Xayrlashuv:   Love, Paul

15-MASHQ JAVOBLARIDAN FOYDALANING:
  1-javob → qayerda ekani
  2-javob → ob-havo
  3,4,5-javob → Sonia (qayerda, nima kiygan, nima qilayapti)
  6,7-javob → Pol (qayerda, nima qilayapti)

DIQQAT — OLMOSH ALMASHISHI:
  Otkritkani POL yozadi → u o'zi haqida 'I' deydi:
     'I'm sitting on the balcony.'
  Sonia haqida esa 'she' deydi.

structure.noteUz: 'Dear + ism' + VERGUL — xat va otkritkaning boshlanishi.

structure.modelEn: The weather is wonderful. It's very hot and the sun is shining.
Sonia is near the pool at the moment.

structure.headingUz: 5-gap: Sonia nima kiygan va nima qilayapti
structure.modelEn: She is wearing her swimming costume and she is sunbathing.
I'm sitting on the balcony of our hotel room and I'm enjoying the wonderful view.
structure.noteUz:
15-mashqning 6 va 7-javoblari.
DIQQAT: Pol o'zi haqida 'I' va 'our' deydi.

'Love' — do'st va yaqinlarga.
Rasmiy xatda 'Yours sincerely' ishlatiladi.

structure.modelEn: Dear Jack, Greetings from Jamaica! The weather is wonderful. It's very hot and the sun is shining. Sonia is near the pool at the moment. She is wearing her swimming costume and she is sunbathing. I'm sitting on the balcony of our hotel room and I'm enjoying the wonderful view. See you soon. Love, Paul
structure.noteUz:
Taxminan 55 so'z — otkritka uchun mos hajm.
Barcha gaplar PRESENT CONTINUOUS'da, chunki hozirgi holat tasvirlanmoqda.

wordFormation.introUz: 31-bet — do'kon iboralari, pul birliklari va kanselyariya so'zlari.

groups.explanationUz: Sotuvchi va xaridor nutqida ishlatiladigan tayyor shakllar.
Ma'nosi o'xshash, lekin fe'l shakli boshqacha.

patterns.formula: Can I help you? — Yes, I'm looking for + mahsulot.
patterns.exampleEn: Can I help you? — Yes, I'm looking for some pencils.
patterns.exampleUz: Yordam bera olamanmi? — Ha, men qalam qidiryapman.
patterns.explanationUz:
'look FOR' = qidirmoq ('for' shart).
Tasdiq gapda SOME ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Do you have any ...? — Yes, of course.
patterns.exampleEn: Do you have any pencils? — Yes, of course.

patterns.formula: How many would you like? — Four please.  /  How much are they? — They're 50p each.
patterns.exampleEn: How many would you like? — Four please. How much are they? — They're 50p each.
patterns.exampleUz: Nechta xohlaysiz? — To'rtta. Ular qancha turadi? — Har biri 50 pens.
patterns.explanationUz: HOW MANY — son (sanaladigan);  HOW MUCH — narx.

patterns.formula: What do you think OF + narsa? — It's lovely.
patterns.exampleEn: What do you think of this T-shirt? — It's lovely.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu futbolka haqida nima deysiz? — Juda chiroyli.

patterns.formula: Otkritka: Dear ... → Greetings from ... → Present Continuous gaplar → See you soon → Love, ...
patterns.exampleEn: Dear Jack, Greetings from Jamaica! I'm sitting on the balcony. See you soon. Love, Paul
patterns.exampleUz: Hurmatli Jek, Yamaykadan salom! Men balkonda o'tiribman. Tez ko'rishguncha. Mehr bilan, Pol
patterns.explanationUz: Otkritkada HOZIRGI holat tasvirlanadi → Present Continuous.
